timing: Supplement specified after the autonomous 16-fit training traces showed unused fits, before scoring any new outer predictions. It reuses the final state of each active16 development path.
question: When the agent voluntarily stops with spare capacity, does its best still-untried affordable method earn a replacement if we keep the already-trained winner frozen?
eligibility: All five active16 runs, no handpicked cases or candidates. Use the last decision's logged ranking. Take its first unseen exploration with capacity for two evaluations and one full challenger refit inside the original total of 16, including the already fitted incumbent. Require an incumbent scored on the primary and at least one confirmation fold. Pick the first numbered such confirmation without reading its score.
test: Keep the incumbent artifact intact. Fit the same prospective challenger on the same primary and confirmation rows as the existing incumbent. Predeclare acceptance only if the challenger beats the incumbent on EACH of the two declared-metric scores and their mean gain is at least 0.003. If accepted, refit on all training data and deliver; otherwise keep the original frozen model. Log the two evaluations even if the first one is disappointing.
budget: Only unused fits of these active16 paths. One challenger per path. Pool with the first study and never exceed its 205 total new-fit authorization. No new model API, access to released packages or official test.
reporting: A conditional counterfactual continuation of observed stop states, distinct from the randomized-free front-to-back schedule comparison. Score the predeclared deliveries after all continuations are frozen. Compare actual alternatives with stopping and report ties, losses and improvements.
